analysis:
PORTFOLIO REVIEW: We are running 86% deployed across 6 positions, which is (a) above the 3-5 concentrated target and (b) leaves only ~$9,051 of headroom for new capital. That headroom is insufficient to size any new position properly: even the cheapest viable candidate requires $15,000-20,000 at minimum sizing (1-2% equity at risk). Opening a seventh position in this environment would be a category error.

EXISTING POSITIONS: UHS (+10.3%) and ULTA (+10.8%) are working well and thesis remains intact — hold for LTCG efficiency. ADSK (+6.2%) and NXPI (+4.1%) are positive with no thesis breaks visible. FOXA (+2.7%) is modest but not alarming. AMP (-4.9%) is the only underwater name and warrants close monitoring — financial services has been choppy and if AMP breaks below its stop level, that capital is better deployed later in a higher-conviction setup. Do not add to AMP here.

MARKET REGIME: Unavailable this cycle, adding uncertainty. With a Sortino of -6.12 and a 1.07 profit factor (barely above breakeven), the evidence argues strongly for patience over aggression.

CANDIDATE REVIEW: Several names are genuinely interesting. REGN stands out: 36% revenue growth, forward P/E of 13x, +23.3% EPS revision in 60 days, clean balance sheet (D/E 8x), uptrend basing near 85% of 52w range — exceptional fundamental momentum but slightly extended technically. TXN shows strong semiconductor cycle recovery (+14.6% EPS revision, 47.5% op margins) but is at 84% of 52w range and not in basing territory. PODD is at 8% of 52w range (ideal Weinstein Stage 1→2 territory) with 19% revenue growth and PEG 1.17, but cannot be sized. EOG and NUE show strong EPS revision momentum but are uptrend-extending, not basing.

DECISION: Zero new trades. Cash is the correct position today. The portfolio is at capacity, the sizing math doesn't work for any new entry, and forcing a seventh position to 'do something' is precisely the behavior this strategy is designed to avoid. Watch AMP's stop level carefully. When UHS, ULTA, or another position closes and cash builds back above 20%, REGN and PODD should be the first candidates evaluated for entry.
